title: Understanding Seal — payload
description: The joining party's proposal of a bilateral agreement (IEEE 7012 pattern: individual proposes, from a standard roster); the host's signed acceptance in the response completes the seal.

roster.description: The standard roster the term is selected from.

term.description: Roster identifier of the proposed term (e.g. SD-BASE).

termsDigest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 pinning the term's three registers (plain-language, legal, machine-readable) as proposed.

termsRef.description: Optional retrieval reference for the pinned term.

agreement.description: The proposed terms. A counter-proposal is a new seal task in the opposite direction, never an edit.

agreementId.description: Present when accepted: the sealed agreement's identifier, carried by understanding/grant.

digest.description: Content digest of the witness record — the attestation from outside both parties that the ceremony happened.

uri.description: Optional retrieval reference for the witness record.

witnessRef.description: Content-addressed witness record: digests and party VIDs only, never ceremony content.
